identityAssessment.finding: The imported northeastern California feature spans approximately 122.09 to 120.25 degrees west and 40.92 to 41.86 degrees north. It represents the broader Achumawi grouping, not only the Fall River Ajumawi band or all members of the wider Pit River Tribe. Local fish-trap findings are explicitly limited to their named setting.

scopeNotes: The wider Tribe’s eleven autonomous bands and the narrower Achumawi grouping are not equated.
No radiocarbon age for a specific surviving fish-trap wall is inferred from neighbouring occupation sequences or the age of lava.
Hudson’s 1902 collection date is not converted into a date of invention; commissioned objects are identified as a possibility.
The CPUC report’s blanket description of the remaining population’s 1859 removal is not repeated as a census-level assertion.
The constitutional 1964 milestone is distinct from cultural origins.
